$comment: How to see the effect of a property editor row. Keyed by sample route, then by the row's key: its PropertyPath, else its Name, else (for generated GUID names, usually buttons) its Label. strategy: change (default) | hover | clickThenChange | press:<row key> | skip. 'at' is a point as fractions of the target's size. 'values' overrides the values tried. 'equivalentToInitial' lists values that look the same as the starting one. 'requires' sets other rows first (and restores them after). 'knownIssue' records a row that is expected not to show a change, and why. Rules apply by regex on the row key when the sample has no entry for that row. strategy 'interact' reloads the sample per value and runs 'steps' ({type: Click|DoubleClick|MouseEnter|KeyDown, cell: [visibleRow, column] | header: column | at: [fx, fy], data: [...]}); grid cells and headers resolve to automation names from the grid's visual model export. 'routeMatch' limits a rule to matching sample routes.

rules.note: Only visible while the pointer is over the plot area.
Activate a cell, press Enter: where the active cell goes.
Edit a cell, press Enter: where the active cell goes after the edit.
Double-click a cell: whether (and how) an editor opens.
Single click: opens the editor only with SingleClick.
Click a cell: what gets selected.
Click two headers: one sorted column or several.
Needs a column or column-edge drag (DragSequence) - left to XSharpTesting.

XAxisMaximumGap.note: The maximum only shows when the gap exceeds it; the sample starts the gap at 0.5.

DataPoints.note: Learned: the point count is used when the data is regenerated.

charts/data-chart/axis-crossing.note: Fixed in the sample JSON: the two crossing rows' property paths were swapped.

ShouldConsiderAutoRotationForInitialLabe.note: Auto rotation only kicks in when the labels are cramped, so the row is driven with the chart narrowed.

AutoMarginAndAngleUpdateMode.note: Only shows when labels need re-fitting, so the row is driven with the chart narrowed.

charts/data-chart/type-scatter-contour-s.note: The ValueCount row needs the resolver's concrete type in its path ('ValueResolver as LinearContourValueResolver.ValueCount'): looked up on the declared ContourValueResolver base it has no metadata and the panel emitted valueCount: null. The panel's JSON builder now accepts 'as Type' on sub-object parts.

Axes[0 as CategoryAngleAxis].LabelMode.note: Auto resolves to Center (CategoryAngleAxis handles them in the same case), so only ClosestPoint shows a difference.

SelectionBehavior.note: Single and multi select look the same with one slice selected; it needs two slices clicked after the change. (chart.SimulateClick at a slice works on WinUI; SimulateInput on charts is WPF only.)

SelectionMode.note: The row has no ValueType or dropdown values in the sample JSON, so it is not driveable as written.

NegativeMarkerVisibility.note: SparklineProfitData has no negative values, so negative markers never draw.

charts/sparkline/markers.note: With MarkerVisibility Visible every point already has a marker of the same size, so the special markers only show with the general ones collapsed.

charts/sparkline/normal-range.note: Fixed in the sample JSON: the editor's Normal Range Minimum now starts at 15, matching the sparkline.
